Tools (59)

  • lock — Lock the vault
  • unlock — Unlock the Bitwarden vault. Takes no parameters. Prompts the user for their master password through a native OS dialog; the password is never exposed to the MCP
  • sync — Sync vault data from the Bitwarden server
  • status — Check the status of the Bitwarden CLI
  • list — List items from your vault or organization
  • get — Get a specific item from your vault or organization
  • generate — Generate a secure password or passphrase
  • create_item — Create a new item (login, secure note, card, or identity) in your vault
  • create_folder — Create a new folder in your vault
  • edit_item — Edit an existing item (login, secure note, card, or identity) in your vault
  • edit_folder — Edit an existing folder in your vault
  • delete — Delete an item from your vault
  • confirm — Confirm an invited organization member who has accepted their invitation
  • create_org_collection — Create a new organization collection
  • edit_org_collection — Edit an existing organization collection
  • edit_item_collections — Edit which collections an item belongs to
  • move — Move (share) a vault item to an organization (formerly the share command)
  • device_approval_list — List all pending device approval requests for an organization
  • device_approval_approve — Approve a pending device authorization request
  • device_approval_approve_all — Approve all current pending device authorization requests
  • device_approval_deny — Deny a pending device authorization request
  • device_approval_deny_all — Deny all pending device authorization requests
  • restore — Restore an item from trash
